answer.rationale: With the line at 94% committed volume and only 14 days until contract expiry, preserving incumbent delivery continuity is the lowest-risk path. A focused negotiation is the single decision most likely to address the mandated spend reduction without introducing migration or delivery risk. Benchmarking and a multi-year/volume structure may improve price and payment terms; the low-cost alternative should not become sole source because of repeated SLA misses. Verify the incumbent continuity and prior negotiation records before committing because the 18% target may not be achievable solely through terms.
